lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill region; the central rows exhibit higher spatial regularity and pixel intensity compared to the ventral clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to create a distinct rectilinear grid across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary linear ridges run horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-like low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high density of distinct, small high-luminance blobs is visible across the entire surface of the large pectoral fin in the foreground.
